title: Travel Agents: Taiwan
subtitle: Your turn = ONE action. Larder caps at 7 (discard down at end of turn).

sections.heading: Do one action
lines: STOCK UP  —  take 2 ingredients where you stand (this region's specialties and/or pantry).
TRAVEL  —  move to a neighbouring region, then take 1 ingredient there (North<->South by HSR).
PLATE  —  spend a Menu dish's recipe from your Larder; log it for VP; refill Menu; Grand Dossier +1.
DEAD-DROP  —  give a rival 1 ingredient; score +1 VP, take 1 Insider Tip, Grand Dossier +1.
EXTRACT  —  catch the last train home: trigger the end-game wind-down.

sections.heading: Insider Tip (free, anytime) — pick one
lines: Take 1 extra ingredient here  ·  treat 1 recipe ingredient as ANY type  ·  Travel 1 extra region.

sections.heading: End and score
lines: End trigger: someone Extracts, OR the Grand Dossier hits its final milestone.
Then finish the round + play one more full round, then score.
Dishes 3 / 4 / 5 VP  ·  Assignment +7 (if done)  ·  +1 VP per Dead-drop  ·  banked Dossier bonuses.
Tiebreak: most dishes, then most regions visited. (Unused Insider Tips = 0 VP.)
